status: Frozen before any final-test image/depth access in this task; no performance-driven amendments permitted

manifest.grouping: environment + numeric trajectory ID modulo 1000, all climates grouped; validate manifest and original pilot metadata before reading test imagery

preprocessing.input: RGB float32 [0,1], full frame bilinear align_corners=False resize 192x320; no augmentation/crop
preprocessing.target: MidAir uint16 PNG reinterpreted float16 metres Euclidean camera range
preprocessing.mask: finite GT in inclusive [0.1,1000]m before nearest depth/mask resize
preprocessing.prediction: FP32 eval batch1, floor .1m, no upper clamp or fitted scaling

metrics.aggregation: pool additive valid-pixel sums/counts over every current frame including unwarped reused predictions; overall and every trajectory; RMSE sqrt pooled squared errors; events pooled counts, ages frame weighted; no averaging trajectory RMSE

v2.sensor_provenance: simulated manifest IMU acceleration/gyro at camera ordinal floor(ordinal*100/25); simulated HDF5 gps/velocity floor(ordinal*frequency/25) zero-order hold (published validation frequency 1Hz). No privileged groundtruth velocity. Ideal common time origin and availability; no measured physical latency. Read only selected split GPS groups; reject insufficient/nonfinite samples. RGB thumbnail 36x64 compared to last inferred frame; risk previous prediction only, no GT mask.

events.definition: valid-GT full-frame p10 <8m and (previous p10 >=8m or previous p10-current p10 >=2m), reset per trajectory; invalid/no-valid p10 infinity
events.rates: missed-update = no fresh inference on event frame; not obstacle-detection correctness. Zero-event rates null/undefined. Delay to next inference same trajectory; unresolved right censored. Offline predicted p10 on GT-valid mask reported separately.

freshness.fixed_budget: approximately uniform positions ceil(k*N/K), includes first frame; report realized max age; age excludes queuing and sensor latency
freshness.selection_limit_scope: validation eligibility only; test violations retained, never used to tune

fixed_budget.source: pooled frozen selected V2 validation calls; same fraction for all unseen trajectories

comparisons.secondary: all policies versus every-frame; V2 versus fixed2 and fixed5; all pairwise tabulation permitted, no new policy

primary_outcomes: near_rmse and near_absrel with near pixel counts
actual model calls and scheduler+inference compute seconds
event missed-update rate, delay distribution, censoring and prediction ages

timing.device: CPU (CUDA device nodes unavailable in current runtime); same hardware/software/FP32/two torch threads for all measurements
timing.warmup: 10 excluded actual forward calls on first validation RGB before EACH measured policy repetition; test 10 identical first-test-frame forward calls per policy, excluded
timing.boundaries: scheduler CPU perf_counter includes thumbnail, motion/risk and decision; inference perf_counter covers host-to-device, actual forward and device-to-host, synchronized for CUDA if supported. Compute=sum scheduler+inference; preprocessing/I/O/scoring/logging excluded, wall separately reported. Preprocessed validation RGB cache allowed; cache generation excluded. Warmups counted separately. Single chronological test traversal with all five policies independently maintaining state; policy execution order cycles by frame to distribute order effects.
timing.summary: individual totals plus median,min,max and max-min spread per policy and per trajectory; no tuning from timing

study_control: require completed three-repeat validation timing, isolation PASS, explicit --allow-final-test and hash-checked protocol; exclusive exposure ledger before first test pixel read. One study, no retries after exposure without explicit report; preserve partial failures. Existing validation runner stays validation-only.
limitations: epoch4 chosen from 50 epochs by AMP validation AbsRel; FP32 audit did not reselect
eight V2 configs plus prior V1 selection on only two validation trajectories; exploratory selection bias; no isolated motion/RGB ablation
custom grouped simulation test with only two paths, not official benchmark; scene/domain overlap possible despite path separation
simulated sensors, ideal latency, reused unwarped estimates; floor saturation and far-depth errors; no measured energy, battery, correct obstacle detection or flight-safety improvement
preservation: all published weights/V1/V2/evidence immutable; no retraining, search, merge or push; regressions retained
